title: Juice & Snack Shop Franchise Opportunity
tagline: Operates a packaged snacks brand focused on making traditional Indian snacking better through palm oil-free and preservative-free products. - Offers a diverse range of products, including Indian snacks, namkeen, cookies, and pickles. - Emphasizes taste and product quality, with management reporting a high repeat-purchase rate among customers. - Follows the brand philosophy of “Snacking Made Better, ” catering to consumers looking for flavorful snack options made without palm oil or preservatives. - Holds GST registration and is developing its brand through a franchise model, offering opportunities for entrepreneurs to establish outlets under the brand. - Seeks to expand its market presence and customer reach through franchise partnerships and wider distribution of its product range.
